description: PAID (x402). For ONE obligation (article-50, article-53 GPAI transparency, dora or cra) and an optional subject via https://councilof.ai/api/evidence-bundle: selected existing card objects with signature fields and any retained inclusion proofs, an OSCAL assessment-results wrapper and an assembly manifest. Assembly does not verify input-card signatures. A returned unsigned manifest reports its signing status and unsigned reason. If signing throws after settlement, the route returns PAID_NOT_DELIVERED without a delivered bundle or manifest; preserve the settlement receipt and reconcile before reissue, without automatically retrying or paying again. Zero selected cards stays an empty bundle; preview=true here, or the free evidence_bundle_preview tool, shows the count first. No new measurement, full OSCAL conformance or conformity determination is established. Article 53 output is evidence for review, not a legal determination; grants no status. Without x_payment the tool returns the actual 402 challenge; read its terms for each request. Supported-card verification is free at https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify. Measurement, not certification.

preview.description: true = the free preview (relevant-card count and first cards); nothing is charged.
